anchors.description: Countertop depth: 3D straight-line distance across one cross-section of the corner worktop, from its front edge above the base-cabinet drawer stack to its back edge at the wall.
anchors.visible_evidence: Continuous pale worktop band at the inside corner between the range and the dish rack; the lower line borders the wood drawer fronts, the upper line is the counter/wall junction, so the segment spans the worktop depth at a single cross-section.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: US kitchen base cabinets are 24 in deep plus about 1 in counter overhang (25 in = 0.635 m); a 600 mm metric worktop or a deeper custom top would differ. Endpoint placement is about +/-5 px, giving roughly +/-0.05 m on this highly foreshortened depth direction.

anchors.description: Width of the white plastic dish-drying rack: distance between the front-bottom left and right corners of its base tray on the counter.
anchors.visible_evidence: White plastic drainer with a flat base and ribbed upright sides, holding plates, standing on the counter left of the sink; both front bottom corners of the base are visible against the countertop.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Specific model is unknown; common plastic dish drainers are about 16-18 in (0.41-0.46 m) wide, but a compact or oversized model is possible, and the right end may include an adjacent utensil holder.
